args.title: Fix password reset email links to not use localhost by default
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email links currently default to "http://localhost:3000" if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set, causing issues for users when running in production or other environments. This change proposes to fix the generation of password reset email links by ensuring the base URL is correctly set by configuration or environment and does not fall back to localhost, which is appropriate for development but not for deployed usage.
